mapper.sql: id, model_code, name, description, thumbnail_image, detail_images, base_price, category, style_keywords, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM design_models ORDER BY model_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO design_models (model_code, name, description, thumbnail_image, detail_images, base_price, category, style_keywords) VALUES (#{modelCode}, #{name}, #{description}, #{thumbnailImage}, #{detailImages}, #{basePrice}, #{category}, #{styleKeywords})
mapper.update: UPDATE design_models SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, thumbnail_image = #{thumbnailImage}, detail_images = #{detailImages}, base_price = #{basePrice}, category = #{category}, style_keywords = #{styleKeywords} WHERE id = #{id}
